tax.note: Clark County ordinance (Senate Bill 1, effective 1 March 2017), combined transient lodging tax schedule: 'Resort hotel within primary gaming corridor ... 13.38%'. Every Strip hotel in this table sits in the primary gaming corridor. Confirm the current schedule before relying on it.

trip.rationale: Chosen automatically on 2026-11-19 from the corrected single-entry set: 2026-12-06 to 2026-12-12 (7 nights, 7 full playing days) carries 12 Venetian full-field entries whose own official structure sheet was read in full and grants no re-entry, rebuy, add-on or purchased-stack entry (about $335,000 of published guarantees across them), plus 7 single-entry satellites into the $2,200 PokerAtlas Championship. No other 7-night window in the series carries more. The window sits inside both verified Strip series (Venetian DeepStack Extravaganza IV, 16 Nov - 23 Dec 2026; WPT World Championship festival at Wynn, 27 Nov - 21 Dec 2026). Every table follows the date filter, so you can move the week without re-entering anything.

budget_ceiling.basis: the average nightly room charge in the only dated booking observation this repo holds (16 Nov 2026 snapshot, 7 nights 2-9 Dec, total $7,054.77 room-only), used as a starting ceiling so the comparison has a bound; no traveller-stated budget exists

budget_floor.basis: the tier of the properties whose official resort fee was confirmed on 2026-11-19 (Venetian $55 plus tax; Wynn $55 plus tax); "best hotels by cost+quality" with quality given priority over distance, and every shortlisted room is on property, so the 30-minute walking limit is met with 0 minutes

rule_standard.text: A Venetian row is published as CONFIRMED SINGLE-ENTRY only when all of these hold, each with the official excerpt and retrieval date shown on the row: (1) its own structure-sheet PDF was read (HTTP 200, full text, SHA-256 recorded); (2) the sheet names that event number; (3) the row is an entry row, not a Day-2 restart or final table; (4) the sheet has no flight or multi-day structure; (5) the sheet states a registration close; (6) nothing in the sheet's numbered rule list grants a re-entry, re-buy, add-on, buy-back, subsequent/additional/second buy-in, or a purchased or alternate stack. Tests (1)-(6) are re-derivable from the stored fields by scripts/check_ea99006a.py.
rule_standard.limitation: No official source in this series states 'one entry only' in words, and every sheet carries 'Management reserves the right to cancel or change the tournament'. Confirmation therefore means 'the published rules grant no second entry', not 'the house promises a freezeout'. That is flag F01 and it stays open.

integration.run_at_note: date only on purpose: a full timestamp would make every scheduled run dirty the data files and produce an empty commit
